help: the merge's relocation alone, on the reader's word (issues/1147) - refuses what the merge refuses before it relocates, relocates onto a moved base as the merge does, and brings every local copy of the branch level with it; no gate, no flip, no squash; each step beneath

explanation.refuses: anything not OPEN, or a checkout that holds the head with a dirty tree (issues/975) - the refusals the merge takes before it relocates, by the one step both take
explanation.relocates: onto the base, only if it moved - in a detached worktree of its own under tmp/forge/rebase/, disposed of whatever happens, so this checkout never moves for it; replaying only the commits the base does not already hold, tree for tree (issues/585); rsc/test/ conflicts are the syntactic class, taken wholesale and settled by the gate's own regeneration; any other conflict halts with the branch and this checkout as found, for the reader to settle by hand - the merge's relocation, by the one step both take
explanation.resyncs: every local copy of the branch, level with the relocated head - reset where this checkout is on it, moved where it is not, by reset and never by pull; a copy holding commits the forge's old head did not is left as it was, and said
explanation.ends: with one verdict - DONE naming the branch, the merge-base it stood on, the base it now stands on and its new head, and what became of the local copy; or NOT DONE naming the refusal or the halt

args.name: pr
args.help: the PR to rebase onto its base, by its number

does: reads the PR's state, base and head before anything else
reads a merged PR's final head for the relocation
reads the PR that introduced a base commit, for the relocation point
reads both refs to judge whether the base moved
reads the head's sha on the forge, the lease the relocation's push is held to
WRITES the relocated head back to the PR, leased against the sha the rebase read - only when the base had moved
